canon.note: Svarog Watches Over You (110702) L10: #1 = 120% to all enemies (AoE), plus #2 = 120% to marked enemies as 4 extra hits of 25% BEFORE the base hit, no Toughness DMG; Marks removed after the Skill. Ultimate (110703) L10: #4 = 25% extra DMG reduction, #3 = 2 turns of greatly increased taunt, #2 = +160% enhanced Counter multiplier, #5 = 2 enhanced Counters. Talent (110704) L10: Counter = #2 = 160% of ATK, #3 = 10% DMG reduction; BA Revenge: Counter DMG +30% -> 208% normal Counter, enhanced Counter = (160% + 160%) x 1.3 = 416% with 50% to adjacent. Basic (110701) L6 = 100%.

fixtures.env: Clara E0 solo vs 3 Physical-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Promise, Not Command (110703) is Clara's Ultimate action (2 casts in the fixture).
Svarog Watches Over You (110702) is her Skill action (4 casts in the fixture).
I Want to Help (110701) is her Basic ATK action (1 cast in the fixture).
The Skill's base hit strikes all 3 enemies per cast (AoE, 110702 #1) — 4 casts x 3 = 12.
Marked enemies take 4 extra hits of 25% each (canon 110702, dealt before the base hit, no Toughness) — 24 extra hits land in the fixture (6 marked instances x 4).
Svarog's Counter (110704) triggers 9 times in the fixture (on every enemy attack against Clara).
Enhanced Counters (110703) hit adjacent enemies at 50% — 4 adjacent hits (2 enhanced counters per Ultimate x 2 Ultimates, last counter was un-enhanced).
I Want to Help hits its single target once (1 cast).
The Basic ATK regenerates 1 Skill Point (110701 sp_base equivalent, 1 cast).
The Skill costs 1 Skill Point per cast (4 casts = 4 SP).
Svarog Watches Over You L10 (110702 #1) base multiplier is 120% of ATK.
Svarog Watches Over You L10 (110702 #2) extra-hit total 120% of ATK over the 25/25/25/25 split; last piece = 0.3.
Normal Counter = Talent L10 160% x BA Revenge (+30%) = 208% of ATK.
Enhanced Counter adjacent damage = 50% of the enhanced main hit ((160% + 160%) x 1.3 = 416% -> 208% adjacent).
I Want to Help at the engine's default Basic Lv6 (110701 L6) totals 100% of ATK.
Over the fixture Clara regenerates exactly 170 Energy (talent counters +5 each, Basic +20, Skill +30, Ultimates consume 110 each).
The Ultimate's taunt/DMG-reduction lasts #3 = 2 turns (110703).
Talent Because We're Family's passive 10% DMG reduction (#3) is a permanent buff.
Mark of Counter persists (engine uses a 999-turn duration; canon: mark stays until removed by the Skill, E0).
A Mark of Counter must exist before the Skill's extra marked-hit can resolve: the first Svarog Counter precedes the first extra hit.
Counters are reactions that occur off-turn: the first Svarog Counter resolves after the first Skill cast's damage.
